items.title: Artie Shaw — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

ctx.x: . . . playing long-form music. The Berezowsky [Nicolai Berezowsky]. De la Joya [?who] did a concerto. And I did the Mozart and the Brahms quintet, and the Mozart quintet, and all of that. I’m going to put out the Mozart quintet and the Berezowsky concerto, which are all on that Legacy album. That’s what I’m going to do. At that time, that’s what I was doing. Getting stuff together, and meanwhile writing. Writing, writing, writing. That’s what I did. I worked at writing like I used to at music.
The book you’re . . . the project you’re on at the moment, this book about Albie Snow, is it?
